headline: Business Insider reports that robotics startup FieldAI is raising $700 million in a deal valuing it at $10 billion, about five times its value a little over a year ago.
score_reason: Kept at 7: a large round in a fast-moving field, but it rests on one unnamed source and the deal may not have closed.
importance_line: It shows how much investors will pay for software that lets robots work in unpredictable places, which concerns FieldAI's customers in construction, data centers and defense and its rivals, but it rests on one unnamed source and the round may not have closed.
summary: Business Insider reports, citing a person familiar with the deal, that FieldAI, which builds what it calls a general-purpose brain for robots, has signed a term sheet (an agreement on the main terms) to raise $700 million at a $10 billion valuation, up from $2 billion. The deal may not have formally closed, it is not clear which investor is leading it, and FieldAI did not respond to a request for comment.
notes: Read the full Business Insider article. One anonymous source; lead investor unknown.
